x-existing-operation-changes.change: emailVerified and active-workspace discovery are delivered; extend current record capabilities with later modules while preserving fields and UUIDs.

Preserve metadata/UUID compatibility; route physical changes through command adapters or return WORKFLOW_REQUIRED. New acquisitions use inventory/opening-balances or accepted receipts. Explicitly review legacy same-department assignee restriction; new custody requires same-company active verified recipient.
Preserve _id and assignment references; include new unit/custody/history projections only when delivered. Redact cost fields under current grants.

Location/department/self union scope is delivered for legacy assets, directory projection and statistics. Extend independent cost visibility with catalog/cost modules. Redact restricted fields before aggregation, directory/recipient projection and response serialization; retain existing compatibility fields that remain authorized.
Location scope and protected-owner invariants are delivered. Extend new business capabilities only with their enforcing modules.
Currency/timeZone, company version and ownership protection are delivered. Future reminder configuration/approval settings remain planned; preserve name/active-only compatibility.
Ownership, invitations, inventory configuration and account-context verification/workspace/acceptance command lookup are delivered. Extend registry/resource authorization with later workflows.

Typed item/lot/unit attachments are delivered. Extend link target FKs, target-specific authorization and read/cleanup rules with each implemented custody/purchasing/service/count module; never admit a free target UUID.

x-capability-expression-rules: Every array entry is required (AND). An entry with OR allows any listed alternative within current resource scope. Conditional field permissions and workflow actor restrictions also apply; role names are never sufficient.
